metric: Native first-publication whole-trajectory independent Sim(3)-aligned camera-center ATE RMSE, metres
aggregation: Average three fresh-process repetitions within each of the 17 fixed sequences, then equally weight sequence means. Reduction calculated from unrounded aggregate means, not a mean of per-sequence percentages.
scope: This is an aggregate system comparison, not an isolated IMU on/off effect.
Sim(3) alignment evaluates trajectory shape and cannot establish absolute metric-scale accuracy.
Do not imply improvement on every sequence: 15 of 17 sequence means and 46 of 51 executions improve.
This fixed historically exposed cohort is not a training-distribution separation or universal generalization claim.
Keep the Sim(3) aggregate title visible when transitioning from single-sequence rigid SE(3) trajectory examples.
